title: How to recover from a stuck PG in Ceph after OSD failure
abstract: This article describes how to identify and recover placement groups (PGs) stuck in degraded, inconsistent, or peering state after an OSD failure in Red Hat Ceph Storage.
issue: After an OSD failure, some PGs remain stuck in degraded+peering or inconsistent state even after the OSD is restored.
solution_resolution:
1. Identify stuck PGs: ceph pg dump_stuck unclean
2. Check which OSDs are affected: ceph pg <pgid> query
3. If PG is inconsistent, initiate repair: ceph pg repair <pgid>
4. If PG is stuck peering, check for blocked OSD connections: ceph daemon osd.X dump_blocked_ops
solution_rootcause: The OSD crash left incomplete write operations that conflict with the PG log. The recovery process cannot automatically resolve these without manual intervention.
